parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The type of vulnerabilities to export. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
app: application vulnerability
emg: emergency vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
要导出的漏洞列表的漏洞类型。取值：

cve：Linux软件漏洞
sys：Windows系统漏洞
cms：Web-CMS漏洞
app：应用漏洞
emg：应急漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of the servers to query for vulnerabilities. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞的服务器的UUID，多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The name of the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞名称
parameters.name: alias_name

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the vulnerability to query. Separate multiple priorities with commas (,). Valid values:

asap: high
later: medium
nntf: low
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞修复优先级。多个优先级使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值包括：

asap：高
later：中
nntf：低
parameters.name: necessity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability is fixed. Valid values:

y: fixed
n: not fixed
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞是否已修复。取值：

y：已修复
n：未修复
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to which the server with the vulnerability belongs.
Call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞所在服务器的资产分组ID。
您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters results by label. Valid values:

<props="china">
Restart required
Remote utilization
EXP exists
Exploitable
Privilege escalation
Code execution
</props>

<props="intl">
Restart required
Remote utilization
EXP exists
Available
Elevation of Privilege
Code Execution

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
按照标签过滤。取值：

<props="china">
需要重启
远程利用
存在EXP
可被利用
本地提权
代码执行
</props>

<props="intl">
Restart required
Remote utilization
EXP exists
Available
Elevation of Privilege
Code Execution

</props>
parameters.name: search_tags

parameters.help_en:
The additional vulnerability type when querying application vulnerabilities. This parameter is required when Type is set to app. The value is fixed as sca.

If this parameter is set to sca, both application vulnerabilities (app type) and software composition analysis (sca type) vulnerabilities are queried. If this parameter is not set, only application vulnerabilities are queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询应用漏洞时的附加漏洞类型。查询应用漏洞（即Type设置为app）时需要设置该参数。该参数固定取值为sca。

如果该参数设置为sca，可查询应用漏洞（app类型）及软件成分分析（sca类型）漏洞，如果不设置该参数，只查询应用漏洞
parameters.name: attach_types

parameters.help_en:
The instance IDs of the VPC-connected instances to query for vulnerabilities. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
Invoke the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询漏洞的VPC实例ID。多个ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: vpc_instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The CVE ID
parameters.help_zh: CVE编号
parameters.name: cve_id

parameters.help_en: The path of the process affected by the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞影响的进程路径
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The name of the container affected by the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞影响的容器名称
parameters.name: container_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the image affected by the vulnerability
parameters.help_zh: 要查询漏洞影响的镜像名称
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range during which the first scan was performed.
The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
首次扫描时间起始时间。
时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: create_ts_start

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range during which the first scan was performed.
The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
首次扫描时间结束时间。
时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: create_ts_end

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether runtime application self-protection (RASP) supports real-time protection against the vulnerability. Valid values:

0: Not supported.
1: Supported
parameters.help_zh:
应用防护（RASP）是否支持实时防护该漏洞。取值：

0：不支持
1：支持
parameters.name: rasp_defend

parameters.help_en: The list of vulnerability component information
parameters.help_zh: 漏洞组件信息列表
parameters.name: vul_entity_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource directory account
parameters.help_zh: 资源目录账户ID
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The asset type where the vulnerability is detected. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:
ECS: host asset
CONTAINER: container asset
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞所在资产类型。多个类型使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
ECS：主机资产
CONTAINER：容器资产
parameters.name: asset_type

schema.description_en: The response for exporting a vulnerability list
schema.description_zh: 导出漏洞列表返回结果

FileName.description_en: The name of the exported file

Id.description_en: The ID of the exported file

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
